gif_metadata.scope: No frame extraction, decoding, rerendering or animation playback

observations.finding: Full mirrored peak and last geometries, gray fixed workpiece, peak tip zoom, and saved force curves are visible at actual x1 deformation. Titles, axes, legends and labels are present without cropping. Orange distances and green rays are explicitly labelled as geometry rather than forces.

The peak tip is close to the lower workpiece face; the annotation resolves the 0.005730316 mm distance that is too small to judge from pixels alone. Peak workpiece Fy grows sharply after the 0.85-to-0.90 mm part of this discrete path. The unloading curve visually retraces loading at this resolution.

Distance and signed Fx panels are complete and legible. The finite tip-to-left-side distance and the left outward first-ray measure are distinct. The dominant approximately 17.7-to-18.0 mm distance compresses the small bottom-gap series vertically; exact values remain in CSV and JSON.

The solid maximum in-plane Green principal strain, free-medium cell-mean J, and free-medium Hu Frobenius fields have complete colorbars. Higher solid strain appears at flexural junctions and left input corners. Medium compression and regularization fields concentrate near the lower face of the fixed square. Only the analyzed lower half is shown in these field panels.

cached_state_evidence.difference_scope: Plain arithmetic on already written JSON values, no new mechanics or constitutive evaluation

metadata_scope.mirroring: Visualization only about native symmetry; lower-body resultants stay half-model quantities; reflected arrows flip Fy, no doubled solved DOFs
metadata_scope.strain_scope: Binary64 in-plane Green eigenvalues from saved F; not fresh HP qualified
metadata_scope.distance_scope: Unsigned finite-segment distance from the recorded reference (80,30) mm node; outward face first rays separately; null=no hit, not zero

nonblocking_display_notes: Wide images are scaled down by inline preview; use the full PNG for small legends and labels.
Only one plotted style per quantity is used for both legs; coincident loading and unloading cannot be separated visually, so the leg and index fields in CSV remain authoritative.
No separate zero-reference outline is overlaid; the peak/last side-by-side views and 24-state GIF support inspection of the physical x1 movement.
The cell-mean J colorbar minimum (approximately 0.01298) is not the minimum Gauss-point J (3.272299e-5). Hu Frobenius plot range is also not the maximum absolute component Hu summary statistic.
physical_limitations: Lower-body forces remain half-model resultants; cached 2|Fy| is the symmetric normal-force magnitude sum, not the assembly net force.
Tip distances, no-overlap observations, a positive J, and force response do not independently certify contact pressure or physical clamping.
These are binary64 saved-F observations; no new high-precision reference or mesh/domain-convergence qualification is supplied.
The workpiece is fixed. These views do not implement a freely moving workpiece, friction, arbitrary-shape studies, or the final HF5 batch-label/ranking task.
